answer.method_summary: Prospective adaptive rule: score every frozen candidate independently with the available item-bound evidence tool. Because all successful evidence was generic ESM-2 sequence plausibility plus ESM-IF1 backbone-conditioned sequence plausibility, and no endpoint-matched measured Growth/SelectionTwo assay outcome was available, use the FM-only fallback: rank higher ESM-2 single-position delta natural-log probability and higher ESM-IF1 mean log likelihood separately, then order by their equal-weight mean ordinal rank (Borda aggregation). Break ties by higher ESM-2 delta, then higher ESM-IF1 mean log likelihood, then lexicographic mutant name. The first ten are selected for the declared higher-is-better Activity/Growth endpoint. The neutral-item designation and label-free context were not used as candidate performance labels. Generic sequence/backbone plausibility is not a causal assay model, may be mechanistically misaligned with growth activity, and should be validated by the declared assay.
